text: `post-api-workspace-projects` names the two refusals of a workspace with a home (PROJECT_PATH_OUTSIDE_HOME, PROJECT_PATH_IS_HOME) but no HTTP status (its linked DTOs carry statusCode null). Assumed: 400 with the `{ error: { code, message } }` envelope, like the route's other caller-path refusals (VALIDATION), so the add-project modal renders them inline.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0602 — PROJECT_PATH_OUTSIDE_HOME / PROJECT_PATH_IS_HOME answer 400 with the error envelope.
